- **[Deputies Elections](https://flow.je/elections/district-3#deputies)**

**[St John Elections](https://flow.je/elections/st-john)**

## Deputies Elections

The 2022 elections are the first to utilise the new electoral districts.

* * *

### 2022 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy (3 seats), 22nd June 2022.

**[Kirsten Morel](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/kirsten-morel), [Hilary Jeune](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/hilary-jeune), [Elaine Millar](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/elaine-millar) and [Andy Howell](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/andy-howell) were elected as Deputies of District 3 in 2022.**

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[Kirsten Morel](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/kirsten-morel)** |  | 2,688 | 70.8% |
| 2 | **[Hilary Jeune](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/hilary-jeune)** |  | 2,601 | 68.5% |
| 3 | **[Elaine Millar](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/elaine-millar)** |  | 2,241 | 59% |
| 4 | **[Andy Howell](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/andy-howell)** |  | 1,722 | 45.4% |
| 5 | [Gregory Guida](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/gregory-guida) | Jersey Alliance | 1,166 | 30.7% |
| 6 | [John Le Fondré](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/john-le-fondre) | Jersey Alliance | 997 | 26.3% |
| 7 | [Mary Venturini](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/mary-venturini) |  | 925 | 24.4% |
| 8 | [Hugh Raymond](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/hugh-raymond) | Jersey Alliance | 421 | 11.1% |

3,796 ballots (inc. 17 spoilt papers)

8,002 registered voters

47.4% turnout

* * *

### 2026 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy (3 seats), 7th June 2026.

- [Hilary Jeune](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/hilary-jeune) : Current Deputy of District 3 \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/03/07/sitting-deputy-to-seek-re-election/)\]
- [Peter McLinton](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/peter-mclinton) : Previous States Member \[[bailiwickexpress.com](https://www.bailiwickexpress.com/news/return-of-the-mac-and-a-former-constable/)\]
- [Kirsten Morel](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/kirsten-morel) : Current Deputy of District 3 \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/03/02/economic-development-minister-to-stand-as-district-deputy-in-june-election/)\]
- [Phil Romeril](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/phil-romeril) : Previous Candidate \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/03/25/value-jersey-founding-member-to-stand-for-deputy/)\]
